metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness over Mayfield, Kentucky higher in November 2021 than on December 10-12, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS nighttime lights data (VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG or VIIRS/DNB/DAILY) - Location: Mayfield, Kentucky (approximately 36.74°N, 88.63°W) - Time periods: November 2021 vs December 10-12, 2021 - For December 10-12, I'll need daily data and composite those 3 days 2. Masking strategy: - VIIRS nighttime data doesn't need cloud masking in the traditional sense - Use quality flags if available - Focus on the avg_rad band (average radiance) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid zero means actual low/no nighttime lights (could be real) - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if pixel counts are 0 after processing (C2) - Check if values are None/null (C3) - Compare November average vs December 10-12 average ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const mayfield = ee.Geometry.Point([-88.63, 36.74]); const buffer = mayfield.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around Mayfield // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Try monthly VIIRS data for November 2021 const novCollection = ee.ImageCollection('VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate('2021-11-01', '2021-11-30') .filterBounds(mayfield); const novSize = novCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`November 2021 images: ${novSize}`); if (novSize === 0) { console.log("No November data found."); console.log("C1"); return; } // For December 10-12, use daily VIIRS data const decCollection = ee.ImageCollection('VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate('2021-12-01', '2021-12-31') .filterBounds(mayfield); const decSize = decCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`December 2021 images: ${decSize}`); if (decSize === 0) { console.log("No December data found."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing const novImage = novCollection.mean().select('avg_rad'); const decImage = decCollection.mean().select('avg_rad'); // Check pixel counts const novCount = novImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const decCount = decImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log(`November valid pixels: ${novCount}`); console.log(`December valid pixels: ${decCount}`); if (novCount === 0 || decCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation const novMean = novImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const decMean = decImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log(`November 2021 mean radiance: ${novMean}`); console.log(`December 2021 mean radiance: ${decMean}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (novMean === null || decMean === null || isNaN(novMean) || isNaN(decMean)) { console.log("Calculation failed - null or NaN values."); console.log("C3"); return; } const difference = novMean - decMean; console.log(`Difference (Nov - Dec): ${difference.toFixed(4)}`); if (novMean > decMean) { console.log("November brightness was higher than December."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("November brightness was NOT higher than December."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
